name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 100% opacity. This gives keyboard users a clear, unbroken ring that survives dark backgrounds and high-contrast modes without fading into noise. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on small touch targets, but the extra 1px width improves visibility for low-vision users and costs nothing in performance.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds—#005. A 1px ring with a 2px outer glow (#005fcc) meets contrast at 4.5:1 while keeping focus visible. Test both in dark/light modes and high-contrast Windows mode—if the glow flickers or feels unstable, revert to the 2px ring.

name: Ramp

Adopt the 1px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px outer glow (#005fcc) at 100% opacity. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 4.5:1 contrast on light backgrounds while keeping focus visible in dark modes and high-contrast Windows mode. The trade-off is a softer ring that may feel less crisp on small touch targets, but the stability and compliance outweigh the visual trade-off. Test in all modes—if the glow flickers or feels unstable, revert to the 2px ring.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring with glow risks blurring into adjacent elements on high-contrast displays—especially when zoomed—because the glow spreads unpredictably. A 2px ring with a 1px inner #fff cutout keeps crisp edges and meets 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds, tested in both modes. Settle it by measuring actual contrast in WCAG tools, not just visual checks.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #fff cutout at 90% opacity. The result must deliver a focus indicator that meets WCAG 2.2 contrast requirements in all modes (light/dark/high-contrast) and remains crisp at all zoom levels. Owner: Ramp.
